newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Innogenetics swings into Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Innogenetics swings into Q1 loss.

text.p: Belgian biotechnology firm Innogenetics NV, which is listed on the small cap market Easdaq, said on Wednesday it had a $0.9 million loss in the first quarter of 1997, reversing a $3.3 million profit in the same period in 1996.
Product sales fell to $3.6 million from $3.9 million and revenues from licence fees plunged to $0.3 million from $3.7 million.
"This is primarily due to the fact that the majority of the licence fees in 1997 are expected to accrue during the second half of the year," the company said.
